en: A vintage black and white portrait of a young woman in early 20th-century attire, arms locked across her chest. In the upper left, there's the text 'HUGO ERFURTH DRESDEN, phot. 1620'. In the upper right, it reads 'JENNY SCHAFFER KGL. S. HOPSCHAUSPIELERIN IN KAMERADEN', suggesting she is an actress in a production. The style, pose, and soft focus are typical of staged studio portrait postcards from the early 1900s.
